articles.title: Hapur: Drunk Man Brutally Slaps Woman in Public, Her Brother Slams Him to Ground; Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur (UP): A shocking video from Mohalla Adarsh Nagar in Hapur has gone viral, showing a drunk young man mercilessly slapping a woman in the middle of the road while bystanders filmed the incident without intervening.

body.html:
Hapur (UP): A shocking video from Mohalla Adarsh Nagar in Hapur has gone viral, showing a drunk young man mercilessly slapping a woman in the middle of the road while bystanders filmed the incident without intervening.

According to police, the man, reportedly drunk, got into an argument with his neighbour on Thursday(17 July 2025) afternoon and began hitting her repeatedly — slapping her nearly 30 times in just 20 seconds.

As the crowd watched silently, the woman’s brother arrived, and when the man tried to hit her again, the brother forcefully slammed him to the ground. The woman too hit back, removing her slipper to strike him in retaliation.

Police admitted the injured man to hospital and later took him into custody. CO City Jitendra Sharma said the woman was sent for a medical examination, and legal action will follow based on her written complaint.

articles.title: CCTV Captures Bhilai Teen’s Death as Speeding Scooty Hits Stray Dog, Falls Into Drain
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bhilai: A tragic accident claimed the life of 16-year-old Raunak Dubey on Monday night in the Supela police station area of Vaishali Nagar, Chhattisgarh, after his speeding scooty collided with a stray dog.

body.html:
Bhilai: A tragic accident claimed the life of 16-year-old Raunak Dubey on Monday night in the Supela police station area of Vaishali Nagar, Chhattisgarh, after his speeding scooty collided with a stray dog.

The incident, caught on CCTV, shows Raunak and his friend riding at high speed when a dog suddenly came onto the road. In an attempt to swerve, the scooty hit the dog, lost balance, and crashed. Raunak fell into a roadside drain, sustaining severe head and chest injuries, while his pillion rider escaped with minor injuries.

Locals rushed both boys to hospital with help from Supela police, but Raunak was declared dead by doctors. The video of the accident has since gone viral on social media.

According to police, Raunak and his friend were on their way to lock a temple when the accident occurred.

articles.title: Monster mother & Lover Party After Suffocating Child Who Saw Them!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: LUCKNOW: Police arrested Roshni Khan (25) and her lover Udit Jaiswal (32) for murdering Roshni’s six-year-old daughter, Sona, in Khandari Bazaar.

body.html:
LUCKNOW: Police arrested Roshni Khan (25) and her lover Udit Jaiswal (32) for murdering Roshni’s six-year-old daughter, Sona, in Khandari Bazaar.

On Sunday night, Sona woke up to find her mother and Udit in a "compromising state." When Sona threatened to expose them to her father, Shahrukh, Roshni pinned the child down while Udit suffocated her.

The duo hid Sona’s body in a bed box, booked a hotel room in Hussainganj, and partied for 36 hours as the corpse decomposed. Roshni later called police, falsely blaming Shahrukh.

CCTV footage traced the pair to the hotel. Udit confessed during interrogation, revealing they killed Sona to silence her. Both are in custody as public outrage mounts.

articles.title: Bike-Riding Molester Attacks Class 12 Girl in Broad Daylight, CCTV Captures Everything
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kanpur, UP - A disturbing case of molestation has surfaced in Kanpur where a motorcycle rider sexually assaulted a Class 12 student in broad daylight on Vishwakarma Mandir Sanigwan Road in the Chakeri area.

body.html:
Kanpur, UP - A disturbing case of molestation has surfaced in Kanpur where a motorcycle rider sexually assaulted a Class 12 student in broad daylight on Vishwakarma Mandir Sanigwan Road in the Chakeri area.

The incident, which was captured on CCTV cameras, shows the accused approaching the girl walking on the footpath and inappropriately touching her before fleeing the scene. The footage has since gone viral on social media platforms.

An FIR has been registered at Chakeri police station, and multiple teams have been formed to track down the accused. However, police have not yet succeeded in making any arrests in the case.

This incident comes despite Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's strong warning that molesters in Uttar Pradesh would face severe consequences, stating that "Yamraj will be found waiting at the next intersection" for anyone who harasses women.

The case has sparked concerns about women's safety in the region, with authorities intensifying their search operations to apprehend the culprit.

Doctors condemned the attack, calling it a daily fear they work under and demanded strict action against the accused. Many questioned why security guards remained passive during the assault and demanded better protection for healthcare workers.

articles.title: Madhya Pradesh MLA’s Son on the Run After Allegedly Trying to Run Over Cops
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | Pushpraj Singh, son of Congress MLA Sena Patel, booked for attempted murder after allegedly trying to run over two constables with a speeding SUV. CCTV shows him ignoring cops & ramming a pole as they narrowly escape. He’s absconding; police on hunt.

body.html:
#InShort | Pushpraj Singh, son of Congress MLA Sena Patel, booked for attempted murder after allegedly trying to run over two constables with a speeding SUV. CCTV shows him ignoring cops & ramming a pole as they narrowly escape. He’s absconding; police on hunt.

* * *

ALIRAJPUR — Pushpraj Singh, son of Congress MLA Sena Patel from Jobat, has been booked for attempted murder after allegedly trying to mow down two constables with an SUV in Alirajpur earlier this week. Singh is absconding, and police have launched a manhunt.

CCTV footage shows Singh driving a speeding, numberless SUV near Alirajpur bus stand, ignoring police signals to stop and charging at two constables. The SUV rammed a pole after the constables narrowly escaped. One constable, Rakesh Gujaria, was injured and is under treatment.

Police said Singh was identified from testimonies, and a DSP-led team is tracking him. SP Rajesh Vyas stated the accused acted deliberately.

The case triggered a political storm, with Singh’s father Mahesh Patel calling it a “false case under political pressure” and vowing to move the High Court. MLA Sena Patel alleged a “well-planned conspiracy” and threatened to raise the matter in the assembly and with the Chief Minister.

Despite the defence, the CCTV visuals clearly show the SUV charging at the policemen before crashing into a pole.
